messages.subject: createShinyGUI() gives inconsistent outputs
parts:
Hi Phil,
I've recently worked on developing a shiny app in which one of the main functionalities is deploying the mirtCAT test object based on the user's selected items. 
The issue I have, as you see in the attached screenshots, is that the mirtCAT session is not displayed when my app is integrated into the master app whereas the exact app doesn't have any problem when it is published separately. I checked the console panel to see if any informative warnings or errors are shown but seems that Rstudio doesn't recognize any errors occurring during the implementation even though the 'Not found' error is displayed on the webpage.
I wonder if you have any suggestions that may help figure out the solution. Below is the relevant code.


insertTab(inputId="tabs",
              position = "after",
              target = "3",
              tabPanel("Sample Assessment",
                       
                       mirtCAT_preamble(
                         df = testset,
                         mo = mo,
                         # # AnswerFuns = answerfuns,
                         criteria = criteria,
                         #start_item = 'MI',
                         design = design_list,
                         #  final_fun = final_fun,
                         shinyGUI = shinyGUI_list 
                       ),
                       createShinyGUI()

I appreciate your taking time in advance,
Jungmin
